seen.numbers_compared: card C=66, U=25; log C=131, U=50. The card's numbers are the log's halved (the card seems to count question+answer pairs, the log single messages). U=50 in the log is far below the runbook's expected 260-290.

why_u_is_small: The chat code keeps at most 200 turns per chat (MAX_TURNS_PER_SLOT = 200). On load, sanitize_slot keeps turns_raw[:200] -- the OLDEST 200 of the 432. On save after the new answer, it keeps turns[-200:]. So the tripled chat became the first 200 turns of the prepended copies plus the new question and answer (file now 200 turns; first turn 'what does the pickaxe do', last the ravenholm question/answer). Only ~200 turns ever reached the summary step, not 432.

verdict_reason: The footer is the 'Too long to read in one go' form, word for word, not the 'Plus the newest N turns' form. But C and U on the card (66, 25) do not equal the log line (131, 50) -- they are exactly half -- and U is 50 in the log, not about 260-290, because the plugin cut the tripled chat to 200 turns when it loaded it. Owner to decide whether halved numbers are the intended units and whether the setup counts.
possible_bug_for_owner: Loading a chat with more than 200 turns keeps the oldest 200 and drops the newest (load uses [:200], save uses [-200:]). In normal use a chat cannot pass 200, so only a hand-edited or old file would hit it.
